bio.text: Brooke Pinto is the Ward 2 Councilmember on the Council of the District of Columbia and chairs the Committee on the Judiciary and Public Safety; she was first sworn in on June 27, 2020, and re-elected in November 2024.
She was the first woman to represent Ward 2 and, per the Council, the youngest member in the Council's history.
Before her election she was an Assistant Attorney General in the DC Office of the Attorney General, including as Assistant Attorney General for Policy and Legislative Affairs.
She earned an undergraduate degree from Cornell University's School of Hotel Administration and a law degree from Georgetown University Law Center.
